props.description: Mustard lounge armchair on oak legs.
Round oak coffee table with a lower shelf.
Small white side table with a drawer.
Brass arc lamp that reaches over the sofa.
Brass floor lamp with a warm shade.
Leafy plant in a terracotta pot.
Desk globe on a wooden stand.
Coat stand with hooks and a hat.
Two-drawer nightstand with a little lamp.
Tall stool with a round oak seat.
Solid oak bench for the dining table.
Solid wood chair with a teal cushion.
Aquarium on a cabinet, fish included.
Striped parasol on a heavy base.
Sliced loaf in its bag, four slices.
Carton of fresh milk, three glasses.
Half a dozen eggs, three portions.
Hot latte to go, a little speed boost.
Solid workbench with a vice and a tool rail.
Aluminium stepladder with a safety platform.
Pallet of paint cans in four colours.
Green garden wheelbarrow on a rubber wheel.
A bag of gummies from the pick & mix.
Spun sugar cloud, freshly made at the machine.
Red candy apple, glossy and crunchy.
Pack of bubble gum, five sticks.
